steps.instruction: Place 1 1/2 cups of shredded dried seaweed in a pot.
Add 4 cups of water to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to keep it bubbling.
Add 3 large cloves of garlic, crushed but not peeled.
Add 1/2 cup of dark Chinese soy sauce.
Add enough boiling water to make about 6 cups in the pot.
Bring back to a boil, then boil fairly high for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bring it back to a boil, then boil fairly high for at least 30 minutes.

steps.instruction: Taste just a little. It is strong.
steps.spoken: Now start to taste, but only a little. It is strong.

steps.instruction: Keep boiling until the liquid has reduced by about half.
steps.spoken: Keep boiling until the liquid has reduced by about half. It will be almost too salty to eat. That tells you to stop.

steps.instruction: Strain through fine mesh or a coffee filter, and let it cool.
